sentence: For food firms, a marketing strategy built on AI raises performance only inside configurations, combined with customer co-creation, marketing capabilities and market orientation
passage: [Wu & Monfort (2023), p. 484] "Data were collected from 278 food firms." / "The research results of FsQCA find that causal conditions of marketing capabilities, customer value co-creation, market orientation, and AI marketing strategy are necessary and sufficient recipes for higher firm performance."

gemini.note: The passage explicitly states that the combination of AI marketing strategy with the other listed factors is a necessary and sufficient recipe for higher performance in food firms, fully supporting the sentence.
